params.prompt: Smooth transition of the same man in the same street. Animate: he walks toward the camera filling more and more of the frame, subtle breathing, hair moving gently, backpack straps shifting. Keep stable: same face, white shirt, black trousers, black backpack, same building and lamp behind, same camera angle, no jumps, no morphing.
params.prompt_cn: 同一男子在同一条街道的平滑过渡。动画效果：他朝镜头走来，逐渐占据更多画面，轻微呼吸起伏，头发轻柔摆动，背包肩带微微晃动。保持稳定：同一张脸、白衬衫、黑色长裤、黑色背包，背景建筑与路灯不变，相同的拍摄角度，无跳切，无变形。

keyframes.role: 镜B极值首帧·人物远景小(1/3)
镜B极值尾帧·人物中近景特写

params.negative: text, watermark, logo, subtitles, morphing, deformed hands, extra fingers, blurry face, frame jump, identity change, clothing change
